title: The projective-line trace and the diagonal integrals
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an integer $n\geq1$, put $A=\Lambda_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. Here Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Put $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Coefficients on each small site are the constant sheaf with value the finite discrete ring $A$. Use ordinary module derived categories and derived direct images on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, sk-def-sfb-finite-derived-functors], not completed coefficient categories. Write $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ and $\nu_T^*$ for the exact comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. On the etale site put $A_{T,\mathrm{et}}(1)=\mu_{\ell^n,T}$, with $\mu_{\ell^n,T}(U)=\{z\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times:z^{\ell^n}=1\}$ and scalar action by powers, and $A_{T,\mathrm{et}}(-1)=\mathcal Hom_A(A_{T,\mathrm{et}}(1),A_T)$ [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf, lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Set $A_T(\pm1)=\nu_T^*A_{T,\mathrm{et}}(\pm1)$. For any complex $K$ on the pro-etale site, write $K(1)=K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A_T(1)$ using derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Let $h=c_1(\mathcal O_P(1))\in H^2(P_{\mathrm{proet}},A_P(1))$ be the pullback of the etale Kummer boundary of $\mathcal O_P(1)$ [lem-amb-kummer-any-base, def-pc-projective-space-twist]. Then:

1. The map given by the unit and $h$,
$$d_q=(1,h):A_S\oplus A_S(-1)[-2]\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*A_P,$$
is an isomorphism in $D(S_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, compatible with every base change $g:S'\to S$, including non-Noetherian $S'$. Put $P'=\mathbf P^1_{S'}$ and $q':P'\to S'$. Compatibility means that the canonical exchange $\beta_g:g^*Rq_*A_P\to Rq'_*A_{P'}$ carries $g^*d_q$ to the same unit-and-Chern-class map $d_{q'}$ on $S'$.
2. Write $b_q:A_S(1)[2]\oplus A_S\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*(A_P(1)[2])$ for the twisted decomposition, whose second component is the adjoint form of $h$. The trace is $\operatorname{Tr}_q=\operatorname{pr}_2 b_q^{-1}$. It is compatible with every base change as above and sends the Kummer class of $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^1_{\bar s}}(1)$, equivalently the class of every rational point of $\mathbf P^1_{\bar s}$, to $1$ on every geometric fibre. The traces on base changes are defined by their corresponding decompositions. The target $Rq_*(A_P(1)[2])$ is the usual notation $Rq_*A_P(1)[2]$ of the blueprint.
3. Put $W=P\times_SP$ [def-pc-fibre-product], let $p_1,p_2:W\to P$ be the projections, and let $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ be the diagonal effective Cartier divisor [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. Let $c_\Delta:\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$ be precisely its cycle class of [sk-lem-geo-cartier], the class used in (G6) of the projective-line adjunction unit. Write $\delta:R\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$ for $c_\Delta$ under the canonical identification $R\Delta_*A_P\cong\Delta_*A_P$ from closed direct-image exactness [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. For $a=1,2$, let $\alpha_a:A_P\xrightarrow{\sim}R(p_a)_*R\Delta_*A_P$ be the canonical derived-composition identification from $p_a\Delta=\operatorname{id}_P$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Then
$$\operatorname{Tr}_{p_a}\circ R(p_a)_*(\delta)\circ\alpha_a=\operatorname{id}_{A_P}\qquad(a=1,2).$$
Thus the displayed integrals include the canonical identification of their source with $A_P$.

In particular, (1)--(2) hold over every scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible: take the Noetherian base $S_0=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[1/\ell]$ and apply the asserted arbitrary-base-change compatibility to its structure morphism $T\to S_0$. This gives exactly the unit, Kummer decomposition and trace over $T$.

Apply the separated diagonal-integral theorem to the selected twisted family and package its result with the base conditions.

Step 1 separates projective qcqs hypotheses from the diagonal Cartier calculation; step 4 separates exact comparison from mate-pasting base-change compatibility; step 7 separates auxiliary etale transport, canonical composite-adjunction normalization, and comparison of the two Chern-class constructions. The statement and route are unchanged, and no new nodes were needed because every extracted argument is supplied by existing cited nodes.

Steps 7--8 realize proof (2), trace normalization, extension to arbitrary bases and rational-point classes. Steps 9--11 realize proof (3): auxiliary etale integral, canonical composite-adjunction normalization, and comparison of the two Chern-class composites for the exact Cartier class fixed by (G5)--(G6).

lean.note: The ordinary small-pro-etale fixed-ring statement, with all maps fixed by their canonical formulas. Noetherianity occurs only in the diagonal clause; clauses 1–2 and their base-change squares cover arbitrary schemes. The diagonal uses the actual Cartier class, specified by its literal Ext comparison with the unique supported Kummer boundary. HEq compares terms of the same fixed Hom/cohomology types and is equivalent to ordinary equality. ULift only places ZMod in the existing module universe; finiteness is supplied explicitly from positivity. The derived diagonal arrow is additionally equated directly to the exact pro-etale derived realization of the same cΔ, using only canonical constant/single/shift transports.
